notes: BLACKOUT SwarmDesk bootstrap on Robinhood Chain (4663). Deploy exactly one SwarmDesk, unbound, with zero deployment value and no initialization calls. Accepted source: identity-md-launches/launch-1544-blackout-swarmdesk-bootstrap-robinhood at 24bfb1d700159042da4b08262927727d37170540 (v3.13). No source changes. Use the unchanged foundry.toml: solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200, cancun, viaIR false, bytecode_hash none. Deploy the creation code exactly as built; its required keccak256 is 0x65968358bcf87aa8839b8bce6b2d339493deac3f77d75a3ff0b3ad4f35955745. The twelve static constructor words are generated by tools/swarm_constructor_args.mjs from docs/oracle-v37/oracle-config.json and docs/swarm-bootstrap-v313/binding.json. Heartbeat is 200 bps with cap 1e18; registry/params launch coordinates remain zero until bind. The oracle evidence context is chain 1; the Desk's EIP-712 domain is chain 4663 and its own deployed address. SwarmDesk is the game's swarm role: it acts only on IMD answers signed by attester 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982 within hard-coded bounds. There is no owner, admin, upgrade or withdrawal; the constructor makes no external call. Deployment service: record and return the confirmed SwarmDesk address and transaction receipt, verify ProjectFactory 0x9c9d2fcb75c2c132c0ac0c42df3819a42347265e predictContract and platform launch registry 0xf52bbe066b7ad2d28c2195d066ea08dcbca88406 isRecorded. Check registry() == 0x0 and bindingConfig().gameConfigHash == 0x11ed7438974e96ecc962201e9c46422c7bf239d725876863fa25a56c734b20d3. Binding is a later permissionless, one-time action proven through the factory; bind immediately after job A, which follows the token launch that initializes the market. Verify the honest job A registry before later wiring or forwarding. Accepted trust assumption: docs/m2-trust-assumption.md, a paid/admitted twin can front-run bind and orphan the honest game (griefing); immediate binding mitigates this. All imported audit low/info findings are accepted without fixes, as documented in ADAPTATION.md: Low 1c443300d9cf4876e25b634b69ec5498b3f1e6ce73e0a8bd1d0c79a508f64083, malformed regulator keys/features clamp to the last supported code rather than skip, while bounds, steps and delays remain enforced; Info 5023720b959e359989175b6d3a5232361ebb87ab6710535f213582938a8c3883, any relayer can submit a signed minimum 5/4-panel answer first and consume that slot; Info ec0a447e962a47dc76cc12660b6b59c19d30f6eab2d5e74f39d499c45ab630b4, immutable protocol configuration has no rotation/recovery setter, so protocol changes can strand oracle operation; Info 01ce7cc9c40f3ef6ff6d717f4a0c9221c57ad5da929845c26201289390d4d63d, stale severity NatSpec: GridOperator accepts 3000 while the Desk clamps to 5000-7000. This condition is unreachable in the required token-launch, job-A, Desk-bind order; cap announcements are proposed only at game age >= 30 days. Reserved Params keys without readers are documented in docs/params-keys-v313.md; changes only write storage and consume cooldown. The committed RepairBps proposal is its default and is skipped.
